errata.orig:
In section 3.1.1.2 Page 8, figure 1,

+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
+                        KDF-AES-128-CMAC                           +
+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
+                                                                   +
+ Input  : MK (Master_Key, the variable-length shared secret)       +
+        : I (Input, i.e., the input data of the PRF)               +
+        : MKlen (length of MK in octets)                           +
+        : len (length of M in octets)                              +
+ Output : TK (Traffic_Key, 128-bit Pseudo-Random Variable)         +
+                                                                   +
+-------------------------------------------------------------------+
errata.notes: In Input, "len" is described as (length of "M' in octets), but there is no "M" in the input, but it is supposed to mention the length of the Input Data "I", so it should be (length of "I" in octets)
